Name: Eat and Drink From Inventory (UNOFFICIAL PATCH)
Author: EphemeralUsage
Description:
[b]THIS IS AN UNOFFICIAL PATCH OF THE ORIGINAL MOD BY Zamiell TO WORK ON VERSION 1.6.14[/b]. [b]THIS MOD IS NOT MAINTAINED.

Link to original mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21280?tab=description[/b]

Additionally, it automatically pauses the game once the consumption animation is completed and returns you to the same facing direction that
you were before.

By default, the hotkey is bound to Q, but this can be changed through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (or by editing the "config.json" file).

(It also allows you to use warp totems and staircases in the same way.)

Manifest.Name: Eat & Drink From Inventory
Manifest.Description: Allows food and drink items to be consumed from the pause screen by pressing a hotkey
Manifest.Author: Zamiel
